_comment: Style read as codification: what each period's manner encodes of the
Style read as codification: what each period's manner encodes of the social,
cultural and political values that produced it, and what it therefore
AFFORDS -- who may enter, who may assemble, what movement is permitted.
This file IS the interpretive apparatus, the same way verbal_vocab.json is the
projection apparatus. Every line is an arguable claim, authored rather than
measured. Edit freely; the prompt builder reads it at run time.
codifies/affords/withholds  the argument, used in the rationale
space/move/light            the ROOM it makes -- these build the prompt,
so that the prompt describes an architecture

01_prehistoric.codifies: collective labour and cosmological alignment before written authority
01_prehistoric.affords: gathering without a centre, orientation to horizon and season, threshold marked by mass rather than enclosure
01_prehistoric.plan: alignment and ring on an unbounded field
01_prehistoric.section: mass resting on ground, weight declared, no floor
01_prehistoric.space: a ring of standing masses on open ground

02_Classical.codifies: civic order as proportional law, the citizen constituted as a measured subject
02_Classical.affords: public assembly under a legible rule, hierarchy argued by proportion rather than force
02_Classical.plan: peristyle and stoa, colonnade defining a public edge
02_Classical.section: column and entablature, load stated explicitly
02_Classical.space: a colonnaded hall open to a public edge

03_medieval.codifies: sacred hierarchy and guild craft knowledge, the body ascending
03_medieval.affords: procession toward a withheld sanctum, refuge, enclosure, verticality as ascent
03_medieval.withholds: the whole seen at once, the lay gaze into the sanctuary
03_medieval.plan: nave and aisle, cloister, cellular accretion over time
03_medieval.section: rib and vault, clerestory light entering high
03_medieval.space: a cloistered nave narrowing to a withheld sanctum
03_medieval.light: high clerestory light falling into shadow

04_renaissance.codifies: humanist proportion and the recovery of antiquity as authority; perspective as a means of owning space
04_renaissance.affords: the single privileged viewpoint, the villa as retreat of a merchant class
04_renaissance.withholds: the accidental, the unmeasured, the collective viewpoint
04_renaissance.section: dome and drum, ideal geometry made constructible
04_renaissance.space: a centralized domed room on harmonic ratios

05_baroque.codifies: absolutism and counter-reformation persuasion, theatre as an instrument of power
05_baroque.affords: staged reveal, movement choreographed toward a focus, emotional subjection
05_baroque.withholds: the plan's logic from the person walking it
05_baroque.plan: oval geometry and undulating wall on a processional axis
05_baroque.section: concealed light source, illusionistic ceiling, vertical drama
05_baroque.space: an oval hall of undulating walls
05_baroque.move: drawn along the axis toward a focus

06_neoclassical.codifies: enlightenment reason and the state's claim on antiquity, empire dressed as republic
06_neoclassical.affords: institutional authority legible at a glance, the civic monument as address
06_neoclassical.withholds: ornament as pleasure, the vernacular, the improvised
06_neoclassical.section: stripped column, austere cornice, daylight admitted as reason
06_neoclassical.space: a porticoed civic hall on a strict axis

07_modernism.codifies: universal rationality and mass production; the refusal of ornament as a moral position
07_modernism.affords: free plan, standardized dwelling, sunlight and air prescribed as social good
07_modernism.plan: free plan on a structural grid, partition released from structure
07_modernism.section: pilotis, ribbon window, slab and roof garden
07_modernism.space: a free plan of slabs lifted on pilotis

08_futurism.codifies: speed and machine violence, rupture with the past as a programme
08_futurism.affords: movement as the organizing value, the city as circulation, obsolescence built in
08_futurism.section: stacked movement, lift towers, oblique ascent
08_futurism.space: terraced decks stacked around lift towers

09_Brutalism.codifies: postwar welfare-state conviction and material honesty held as ethics
09_Brutalism.affords: monumental public provision, mass as permanence, the megastructure as social container
09_Brutalism.withholds: the polite facade, the disguise of structure
09_Brutalism.plan: cellular aggregation and deck access within a megastructure
09_Brutalism.section: board-marked concrete, deep overhang, heavy cast shadow

10_deconstructivism.codifies: refusal of stable hierarchy, institutional critique turned aesthetic
10_deconstructivism.affords: disorientation, no privileged viewpoint, programme without given order
10_deconstructivism.withholds: orientation, the horizon, the reliable floor
10_deconstructivism.plan: fractured and skewed geometries in collision
10_deconstructivism.section: tilted plane, unresolved intersection, void cut through
10_deconstructivism.space: fractured planes colliding over a cut void

11_High Tech.codifies: structure and service exposed; flexibility as an ideology of capital
11_High Tech.affords: adaptable interior, legible infrastructure, the building as a machine to be maintained
11_High Tech.withholds: the fixed room, the settled programme
11_High Tech.plan: served and servant zoning across a clear span
11_High Tech.section: exposed truss, external service tower, suspended floor
11_High Tech.space: a clear-span shed served by external towers
11_High Tech.move: moving between served and servant zones
11_High Tech.light: even light through a glazed envelope

12_parametric.codifies: optimization as authority, computation displacing the author
12_parametric.affords: continuous variation without repetition, smooth control, the crowd modelled as flow
12_parametric.withholds: the joint, the module, the discrete decision
12_parametric.plan: continuous differentiated field, no repeated bay
12_parametric.space: a continuous differentiated field under a seamless shell

14_postmodernism.codifies: the return of the sign and of irony, historical quotation detached from belief
14_postmodernism.affords: communicative facade, pluralism as consumer address, contradiction tolerated
14_postmodernism.section: applied pediment, layered facade, colour as speech
14_postmodernism.space: a quoted facade fronting a collaged plan
14_postmodernism.move: addressed by signs at the approach
14_postmodernism.light: flat even light on applied colour

15_mannerism.codifies: deliberate rule-breaking by those who hold the rule, anxiety inside a mastered language
15_mannerism.affords: the knowing viewer, ambiguity as sophistication, discomfort staged as wit
15_mannerism.section: broken pediment, interval stretched past ease
15_mannerism.space: a compressed room of strained proportion
15_mannerism.light: uneasy light over a split pediment

16_industrial.codifies: production placed before representation, the shed as pure economy
16_industrial.affords: span, throughput, labour organized by the plan
16_industrial.plan: repetitive bay across a long span
16_industrial.section: truss and sawtooth roof, top-light over the floor
16_industrial.space: a long-span shed of repetitive bays
16_industrial.move: moving with the throughput of the floor

fusion._comment: How the second codification acts on the first, spatially. Chosen by cross-protocol agreement at the point.

drawing._comment: The drawing convention, kept short so the space description has room.
drawing.base: abstract architectural drawing, plan and section fused, orthographic hard line, hatched poche

_comment: A rift is not two different periods -- adjacent periods differ constantly
and agree about nearly everything that matters. A rift is where two
codifications pull OPPOSITE ways on the same question about who
architecture is for. Positions are -1..+1 per axis, authored and arguable.
rift_atlas.py scores a neighbourhood by weighted polarisation along each
axis and selects the points where a single axis is most torn.

legibility.neg: the order withheld from its occupant
legibility.pos: the order legible at a glance

labour.neg: the hand and the guild visible
labour.pos: the machine and the standard visible
